retired.why: Unfalsifiable by construction. The trial deleted the `!matches!(Regular)` half of `declares_digest`, but `ensure_materialized` already returns immediately for an overlay file, so the mutant fetched nothing, hashed nothing, and behaved identically. The survivor was not a missing test — it was a redundant guard, and the guard was removed instead.
